items.finding: Read and rendered the complete one-page source. B2800-49 identifies internal SRS failure, with 10–16 V supply, ON mode, approximately 6 seconds, one drive cycle and SRS indicator. The low-voltage warning below 10 V and incomplete-cause-list caveat support the article. The source says fail-safe action None; the article correctly avoids interpreting that as a restraint-availability guarantee. No correction identified.
